profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a public company headquartered in Miami, Florida, and trades under the ticker HUT. On its website it describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies.

The company says its portfolio of businesses provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining. It also announced that it has fully commercialized a 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, bringing campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion.

The company's recorded litigation exposure is in Florida, with a count of 75.
